description.zh: 是否移除实例上的所有标签。默认否。
description.en: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instances. Default value: No.
The ID of the region in which the instances reside.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 要操作的原生防护实例的ID。n的取值范围为 \[0, 49]，用于指定多个实例，最多50个。例如：ResourceId.0，ResourceId.1，...，ResourceId.49。
description.en: The IDs of the instances. Valid values of N: 0 to 49. You can specify up to 50 instances at a time. Example: ResourceId.0, ResourceId.1, ... , ResourceId.49.
The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

description.zh: 要移除的标签键。n的取值范围为 \[0, 19]，用于指定多个标签键，最多20个。例如：Tag.0.Key，Tag.1.Key，...，Tag.19.Key。
description.en: The keys of the tag that you want to remove. Valid values of N: 0 to 19. You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time. Example: Tag.0.Key, Tag.1.Key, ... , Tag.19.Key.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp untag-resources --resource-group-id test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-v0h1fmwbc024 --tag-key testKey1 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddosbgp UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'ddosbgp-cn-v0h1fmwbc024' --ResourceGroupId test --TagKey.1 testKey1 --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
